The average-value and the regular average-value problems for VASS(N) and uniform cost functions with non-zero coefficients are decidable and mutually reducible to the configuration reachability problem for VASS(N). We have used in the proof the fact that f depends on all counters. We conjecture that this assumption can be lifted: I Open question 5. Is the average-value problem for VASS(N) and uniform cost functions decidable? 4 General cost functions and VASS(Z) First, we consider (an extension of) the regular finite-value problem for VASS(Z) (Section 4.1). We show that one can decide in non-deterministic polynomial time whether a given VASS has a regular computation (a) of the value −∞, or (b) of some finite value. To achieve this, we introduce path summarizations, which allow us to state conditions that entail (a) and respectively (b). We show that these conditions can be checked in NP.
